titulo: Light and at your own pace
lead: For people with little mobile data, a weak connection or little time. What you choose here stays on this device. Only the post you publish and the quiet hours for notifications go to the server.

economia.dica: A post photo becomes a tile and only opens when you tap it; video only plays when you ask. No animation, and the fonts your device already has.
economia.automatico: Your device asked to save data, so Alumia light started switched on. You can switch it off here.

linha.dica: The timeline without photos, video or decoration. Each image only loads if you tap it.
linha.semRede: No connection right now. When it is back, tap Try again.
linha.visitante: Sign in to your account to see the timeline.

escrever.dica: Without a connection, the post is kept only on this device and goes out by itself when the connection comes back, with Alumia open. Nothing waits on the server.
escrever.rotulo: What do you want to say?
escrever.guardar: Keep it to go out when the connection is back
escrever.comRede: Connected: the post goes out now.
escrever.semRede: No connection: the post is kept on this device.
escrever.guardado: Kept on this device. It goes out by itself when the connection is back, while Alumia is open here.
escrever.repetido: This text was already kept. We do not keep it twice.
escrever.cheia: There are already {max} posts waiting on this device. Send or delete one first.
escrever.semEspaco: The device has no space to keep it. Nothing was kept.
escrever.naoMembro: To write, sign in with your approved account.
escrever.soTexto: Only text here. Photos, polls and actions go through the usual Write, with a connection.
escrever.previa: In the preview nothing is published: the post only goes into this device's queue.

fila.apagarConfirma: Delete this kept post? It disappears from this device and is not sent.
fila.parado: Kept for more than {dias} days: it does not go out by itself. Send it now or delete it.
fila.recusado: The server refused it. {motivo} Delete it and write again, or send it again.
fila.outraConta: Kept by another account on this device. It only goes out when that account signs in.
fila.saiu: The post kept on this device went out.
fila.saiuVarios: {n} posts kept on this device went out.
fila.naoSaiu: A kept post did not go out. See Light and at your own pace.
fila.sairRapido: Quick exit deletes this queue together with everything else Alumia keeps on the device.

tempo.dica: The clocks are only on this device: no score, no history, nothing goes to the server.
tempo.pararDica: One reminder per night, at the time you choose, up to five hours after it.
tempo.lembreteTexto: The struggle continues tomorrow. Resting is also caring for the collective.

silencio.dica: You choose the time on this device's clock. The server keeps only the minutes of the day, with no time zone and no city.
silencio.visitante: Sign in to your account to choose the quiet hours.

ajustes.titulo: Light and at your own pace
ajustes.texto: Data saving, Home in text only, posts waiting for the connection, time to stop and quiet notifications.
ajustes.abrir: Open Light and at your own pace

offline.aviso: No connection right now: nothing was sent. The text is still here. To have it go out by itself when the connection is back, use Light writing, in Light and at your own pace.
offline.jaSaiu: This same text has just gone out, kept on this device, when the connection came back. We are not publishing it again.

erros.desconhecido: The server did not say why.
